text:
Maya Patel: FYI PR #428 updates audit export docs. Need SOC2-compliant wording + a clear example CLI for exports + a retention TTL example. Legal asked for explicit language around default windows and how to request extensions. PTAL

Alex Chen: Which section? I skimmed earlier and saw a TODO that said 'we keep audit logs as required' — that's way too vague for SOC2.

Maya Patel: Lines ~42-58 in the current diff. Current text: 'we keep audit logs as required by request' — legal wants something like explicit defaults and a path to request extensions, plus mention of KMS/HSM and redaction behavior.

Sarah (legal): Suggestion: use: 'Default retention: 90 days for hosted audit logs. Customers on Enterprise may request extended retention up to 7 years via a contractual amendment or the legal_hold API. Redwood will document retention requests and approvals.' Also add: 'Exports are delivered encrypted; keys are customer-managed where applicable. We support field-level redaction upon export request.' We can't promise indefinite retention without contract.

Samir Gupta: I'll add the suggested language to PR and include an updated curl snippet showing retention param + legal_hold flag. Draft snippet below — open to wording tweaks:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/exports \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"time_range": {"from": "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z", "to": "2025-06-01T00:00:00Z"}, "retention_ttl_days": 365, "legal_hold": false, "redact_fields": ["user_email"]}'
```

Alex Chen: That looks good. Two copy edits: change 'we keep' -> 'Default retention is' and include a link to the retention config doc. Also show an example for how to request an extension (API + email path).

link-checker-bot: :robot_face: automated check: /docs/retention-config currently 404 on staging. If the PR adds that anchor, the link checker will fail until the page exists. Recommendation: link to the 'Retention overview' section instead, or add a temporary note and a follow-up ticket to create the new page.

Maya Patel: OK — we'll point to the 'Retention overview' anchor for now and file a follow-up to create /docs/retention-config. @Alex can you add an example that sets legal_hold: true and show the downstream comment about redaction?

Alex Chen: On it. Will also add a small Python SDK snippet for parity. Draft Python snippet:

```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = client.audit.exports.create({
  "time_range": {"from": "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z", "to": "2025-06-01T00:00:00Z"},
  "retention_ttl_days": 365,
  "legal_hold": True,
  "redact_fields": ["user_email"]
})
print(resp.id)
```

Samir Gupta: Nice. @Sarah, question on phrasing: we have a sentence 'Customers are responsible for downstream PII handling unless using Redwood redaction at export.' Legal prefers softer language. Proposed: 'Customers should evaluate their downstream obligations and may opt into Redwood's export redaction features where available.' Does that read OK?

Sarah (legal): That reads better. Minor tweak: 'Customers should evaluate their downstream obligations and may opt into Redwood's export redaction features. For high-sensitivity requests, customers should notify Redwood Legal to enable contractual protections (see /docs/soc2-controls).'

Maya Patel: Great. I'll update the PR with the final language, point the docs link to Retention overview (temporary), and add a note referencing tracker.redwood.com/RET-1123 to create /docs/retention-config.

Alex Chen: Pushed final edits: replaced vague phrasing, added legal_hold example, included Python + curl snippets, and swapped the link to the Retention overview anchor.

Samir Gupta: Running link checker again locally, looks clean aside from the staging 404 which we acknowledged. I'll add a short inline note: "(link to retention-config to follow; see RET-1123)"

Maya Patel: Thanks everyone. Once CI passes I'll merge. Filing follow-up for retention-config page and for adding Go SDK parity: RET-1123, RET-1124.

Alex Chen: Merged with small copy tweak. cc @all :shipit: 

link-checker-bot: :white_check_mark: link check passed on main after merge (staging still shows 404 for the new page).
